name: DrivingBench
description: Closed-loop benchmark suite for multi-ability evaluation of autonomous driving models and vision-language agents on perception, planning, and control.

datasets.name: DrivingBench Core Dataset
datasets.description: Multi-scenario closed-loop simulation routes and sensor data for autonomous driving benchmark evaluation.

metrics.name: Driving Success Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of benchmark driving routes successfully completed without collisions or traffic rule infractions.

inference_environment.description: CARLA / closed-loop simulator environment running multi-camera vision-language inference.

test_method: Evaluates vision-language models and end-to-end driving agents in closed-loop CARLA simulator routes by processing multi-view camera feeds and predicting steering, velocity, and waypoints.
notes: Evaluates closed-loop driving ability, reasoning under long-tail traffic scenarios, and real-time execution safety.
